en.title: New Track Chair Enhances Park Accessibility; Surveys and Services Drive Disability Inclusion
en.summary: A new track chair has been introduced at Lake Guntersville State Park, improving mobility access for visitors with disabilities. In Fukuchiyama, a new support window offers visually impaired individuals information on assistive technology, while residents in Missoula surveyed West Broadway for accessibility barriers. Meanwhile, the Youth Symphony Center seeks community help to add ramps and assistive listening devices, and a theatre review highlights how a deaf musician experiences music through vibration in an accessible show.

highlights.title: New track chair improves accessibility at Lake Guntersville State Park
New Support Window for Visually Impaired in Fukuchiyama

The Singer review – deaf musician experiences music through vibration in accessible theatre show

zh-TW.title: 新型越野輪椅改善公園無障礙
zh-TW.summary: 湖岡特維爾州立公園新增一台越野輪椅，提升殘障訪客的行動便利。福知山為視障者新設支援窗口，提供輔助科技與日常生活工具資訊；密蘇拉西百老匯居民進行調查，評估人行道與坡道縫的無障礙情況。青少年交響樂中心尋求社區協助安裝輪椅坡道與助聽裝置，而劇場評論指出聾人音樂家透過Subpac設備感受音樂，展現藝術無障礙。
